AcceptedBody.description: 202 Accepted body for a large trace. Served at HTTP 200 by the live handler (the two shapes share the success status; see SPEC T-35 Wave 1).
AcceptedBody.title: AcceptedBody

CurrencyId.description: ISO 4217 numeric currency code; the catalog row lives in the database.

DimensionKind.description: The sealed kernel dimension set. Adding a variant is a kernel change and a migration, never a customization. Modules cannot extend it.

oneOf.description: Duration. Labor-hours may or may not live here; `TimeDim` exists either way.
Both directions from the same start.

ExpiryPrecision.description: Expiry precision. A bare `DATE` is forbidden (invariant 12).

oneOf.description: Calendar month; stored as the first of that month.

ExpiryWire.description: Wire expiry `{value, precision}` (`docs/10` §3.4). Month/year omit an invented day.

value.description: Value formatted to the claimed precision (`YYYY-MM-DD` / `YYYY-MM` / `YYYY`).

Impact.description: Recall list: forward closure to CUSTOMER boundary postings (D2 case g).

customers.description: Customer / sales-order references on those documents.

shipments.description: Inventory shipment documents that reached CUSTOMER.

Impact.title: Impact

residual_tolerance.description: Residual tolerance as a decimal string.

oneOf.description: Exhausted retries or fatal handler error.

JobStatus.description: Snapshot of a job row for readers.
JobStatus.title: JobStatus

LotStatus.description: Lot / serial status. Inventory posts the corresponding movement; this module records the status and its history only.

OnHandBody.description: GET `/api/v1/inventory/on-hand` body. Amounts are decimal strings, not `AnyQuantity`.
OnHandBody.title: OnHandBody

PrincipalBody.description: GET `/api/v1/identity/me` (and principal read) body. Timestamps stay RFC 3339 strings at seconds precision, matching the previous `json!` emission.
PrincipalBody.title: PrincipalBody

Tree.description: A forest returned by a single-direction trace.

TreeNode.description: One node of the genealogy tree the mockup draws.

amount.description: Edge amount into this node (wire shape of [`wicket_core::Money`]). `serde(with = rust_decimal::serde::str)` so the wire is a string; a bare derive would not compile and a numeric schema would disagree with the wire.

item.description: Item on the lot, when the posting carries a lot.

location.description: Location, when known from a published inventory document.

UnitId.description: Opaque catalog identifier. Core never interprets the catalog.

info.description: Wave 2s slice. The UI consumes this document (ADR 0009).
info.title: Wicket HTTP API
